basis: No explicit Schema-V2 enforcement carrier exists.
Three exact representation-policy assertions lack explicit machine-checkable Schema-V2 carriers.
Reviewed field-level lossless reverse reconstruction remains unproven for additional rule and exit-obligation fields.

alternative_C_repurpose_unrelated_existi.reason: Semantic-field repurposing does not establish an admissible exact inverse representation.

alternative_D_opaque_packing_or_external.reason: The reviewed contract disallows opaque packing and external lookup substitution as a substitute for semantic representation.

alternative_E_semantic_accounting_only.reason: Forward/reverse unit accounting binds source units to carriers but does not itself encode missing source semantics or prove field-level exact reverse reconstruction.

must_preserve_enforcement_semantics.minimum_requirement: A machine-checkable semantic carrier or carrier composition must preserve each source enforcement classification without semantic strengthening, weakening, opaque packing, or external lookup and must support deterministic exact reverse reconstruction.

must_preserve_three_representation_polic.minimum_requirement: Explicit machine-checkable preservation and exact reconstruction of the normative-strength uncertainty policy.
Explicit machine-checkable preservation and exact reconstruction of the resource-centered policy.
Explicit machine-checkable preservation and exact reconstruction of the prohibition on invented synthetic protocol events.

SA04_complete_field_level_scope.important: The successor scope must not be artificially narrowed to enforcement plus three policy fields; every V4 source field must be either directly preserved or covered by a reviewed deterministic semantic decomposition and inverse reconstruction proof.

SA05_semantic_accounting_boundary.minimum_successor_requirement: Semantic accounting may continue to provide forward/reverse source-unit traceability, but each referenced destination carrier must itself semantically encode enough information for deterministic preservation and exact reverse reconstruction.

SA06_backward_compatibility_and_migratio.migration_policy: No mandatory migration of already frozen zlib/libpcap specifications is justified by the curl-specific successor requirement. Any successor applies through separately reviewed version dispatch and explicit document schema_version binding.

SA07_minimum_future_governance_sequence_: Independently review and approve this necessity/scope assessment.
Author a successor candidate without modifying historical Schema V1 or active Schema V2 artifacts.
Machine-check the successor against the minimum semantic-carrier and roundtrip requirements.
Conduct independent human technical review of the successor candidate.
Separately finalize successor hash/canonicalization and version-dispatch governance.
Separately authorize and execute successor activation.
After activation, separately authorize a positive curl V4-to-successor mapping contract.

Machine-check and independently review exact forward preservation and reverse reconstruction for all V4 semantic containers, 64 rules, three exit obligations, policy assertions, and all source fields.
Only after the positive mapping is approved may curl canonical materialization be separately authorized.
Analyzer implementation/execution remains outside this assessment and requires its own project-stage authorization.

SA08_conclusion.bounded_interpretation: A schema successor is required if the project continues to require exact lossless canonical representation of curl V4 under the existing reviewed admissibility constraints. This is not a claim that Schema V2 is generally invalid or information-theoretically incapable under arbitrary encoding rules.
SA08_conclusion.why_FURTHER_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED_not_select: The evidentiary question of the identified Schema-V2 residual insufficiency has already undergone independent review, corrective provenance rereview, and closure. The unresolved issue is now representational capability, not missing review evidence.
SA08_conclusion.why_NO_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED_not_selected: No admissible deterministic exact V4-to-existing-V2 mapping path has been proven, while the residual Schema-V2 insufficiency proof and its corrective review chain are complete and PASS_CLOSED.
